prerequisites: Written and oral comprehension of Italian language.
Basics of algebra, analytical geometry, and calculus.

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with the basic knowledge required for the comprehension of fundamental physical phenomena.
Develop skills in tackling easy problems in a quantitative and rational way.

syllabus_topics: Motion of a particle subject to gravity.
Nonconservative forces and conservation of total energy.
Kinematics and dynamics of rigid body.
Thermal equilibrium termico and zeroth law of thermodynamics.
Specific heat, latent heat, and phase transitions.
Heat engines, refrigerators, and heat pumps.

assessment_methods.method: Written test (answer to questions and quantitative problem resolution)
Oral examination (possible, subject to decision of examining board)

assessment_rules: The written test includes answering questions and solving quantitative problems. During the written test, calculators, texts, and notes are not allowed. The evaluation is made known to the student through the ESSE3 platform. An oral examination is possible, subject to the decision of the examining board.
bibliography: Halliday-Resnick-Walker, FONDAMENTI DI FISICA vol. 1, CEA
Serway-Jewett, FISICA PER SCIENZE E INGEGNERIA vol. 1, Edises
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Informatica (Electronic And Computer Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
